admin.modules.removeDenyWhat: The deny ends and the plan decides again. If the plan includes this module, the organization can switch it on again.
admin.modules.removeGrantWhat: The grant ends and the plan decides again. If the plan does not include this module, the organization can only read it for 30 days (view and export; no changes, its jobs stop), then loses it. Its data is kept.

admin.ops.transport.reason.dns_failed: The sensor host name does not resolve from the platform itself, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC, add a DNS record for it.
admin.ops.transport.reason.foreign_certi: The gateway in front of the platform terminates TLS, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC on the same port, enable the sensor gateway mode.
admin.ops.transport.reason.handshake_fai: The TLS handshake with the gRPC endpoint failed, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC, make sure the gateway passes sensor connections through to the API.
admin.ops.transport.reason.http2_refused: Something in front of the gRPC endpoint speaks only HTTP/1.1, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC, allow HTTP/2 end to end.
admin.ops.transport.reason.listener_fail: The gRPC listener could not start, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. The API log names the port it could not open.
admin.ops.transport.reason.no_public_hos: The platform does not know the address sensors reach it on, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC, set SENSOR_PUBLIC_HOST or the platform URL.
admin.ops.transport.reason.other: Sensors use the HTTPS binding: the platform's own check of its gRPC endpoint did not pass.
admin.ops.transport.reason.probe_pending: The platform is still checking its gRPC endpoint; sensors use the HTTPS binding meanwhile.
admin.ops.transport.reason.sensor_ca_una: The sensor certificate authority is not loaded, so sensors cannot get the client certificates gRPC needs and use the HTTPS binding. Check the sensor CA settings on the API.
admin.ops.transport.reason.transport_off: Sensor protocol v3 is switched off on the API (SENSOR_TRANSPORT_V3=off), so every sensor uses protocol v2. Set it to auto to serve protocol v3 again.
admin.ops.transport.reason.unreachable: The platform cannot reach its own gRPC endpoint, so sensors use the HTTPS binding. To let them use gRPC, open that port and forward it to the API.
